newsitem.title: NORWAY: POLL - ANALYSTS MIXED ON NORWAY SEAFOODS.
newsitem.headline: POLL - ANALYSTS MIXED ON NORWAY SEAFOODS.

text.p: Norway Seafoods ASA, the world's largest catcher and processor of white fish, is expected to post pre-tax profits in the first half of 116 million crowns, according to a Reuters poll of five analysts.
Two of the analysts recommended a buy on the share, two said hold and one declined to provide a recommendation.
Norway Seafoods is a subsidiary of Norwegian holding company Aker RGI ASA and was listed on the Oslo bourse on May 16.
The analysts said the stock had faced an uphill battle since its listing, which began when U.S.-based investment fund Tiger Management Fund failed to place its whole stake.

Tiger opted to sell around 8.4 million shares to Aker RGI through an options transaction and Aker RGI, in turn, sold half of the stake at 50 crowns per share, five crowns under the introductory price.
The market has since waited for Aker RGI to place the remainder of the stock, the analysts said.

Norway Seafoods also had its application for a licence to fish in Chilean waters rejected, leaving the company's 400 million crown showpiece fishing vessel, American Monarch, idle in Seattle, Washington in the United States.
The company is appealing the decision by the Chilean crown court, but it booked a loss on the vessel in the first quarter of 14 million crowns.
The analysts said the share debacle at listing and the difficulties in Chile were reponsible for the flat development of the share.

"The share has a problem because of the overhang of more than four million shares still in Aker RGI's hands. No-one wants to take a significant stake (in Norway Seafoods) in case Aker RGI suddenly comes on to the market with the block," said one of the analysts.
However, once the block is placed in the market that analyst saw potential for the stock to rise to 80 crowns in a 12-month prospective. On Friday the stock stood at 50 crowns.
Norway Seafoods will present first-half results at 0630 GMT on August 12. Following lists analysts' expectations:
(millions of crowns unless stated)
Average High Low
Operating revenues 3,041 3,125 2,825
Operating result 147 173 130
